issues.issue: The arithmetic is exact and defensible under the relaxed rule 3. The Inheritance Tax Fund's 100,779 falls in 'Other taxes' by its fund name. The nonmajor 52,136, though, is a combined column whose tax type isn't printed (p12 'Taxes' 52,136; p14 shows only total receipts per fund). The nonmajor funds that could plausibly collect taxes are Visitor Promotion/Improvement (lodging) and 911/Wireless 911 (surcharge), all 'other' types, and no nonmajor fund is a property-tax levy fund, so General = property + motor vehicle is well supported. It is still an inference from fund names, not a printed fund-level figure.
